sql: SELECT TOP 10 o.ClassNumber AS pendingOrderNumber, s.OrderStateName AS status, o.OrderDate AS orderDate, c.pendingCount AS pendingCount, c.pendingApprovalCount AS pendingApprovalCount, c.approvedCount AS approvedCount FROM dbo.ZnodeOrder o INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeCPOrderClass oc ON oc.CPOrderClassId = o.ClassId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = o.PortalId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeOmsOrderState s ON s.OmsOrderStateId = o.OmsOrderStateId CROSS APPLY (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.OrderId) AS pendingCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ps.StatusCode = @pendingApprovalCode THEN p.OrderId END) AS pendingApprovalCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ps.StatusCode = @approvedCode THEN p.OrderId END) AS approvedCount FROM dbo.ZnodeOrder p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeOmsOrderState ps ON ps.OmsOrderStateId = p.OmsOrderStateId WHERE p.UserId = o.UserId AND p.PortalId = o.PortalId AND p.ClassId = o.ClassId AND ps.IsAccountStatus = @accountStatus) c WHERE oc.ClassCode = @pendingClass AND po.StoreCode = @store AND s.IsAccountStatus = @accountStatus AND (@owner IS NULL OR o.UserId = @owner) AND (@status IS NULL OR s.StatusCode = UPPER(@status)) AND c.pendingCount >= @minPendingOrders AND (@maxPendingOrders IS NULL OR c.pendingCount <= @maxPendingOrders) AND (@preferred IS NULL OR o.ClassNumber = @preferred) ORDER BY o.ClassNumber
